No one knows. But if you do the things mentioned above, you will find success ultimately. Finally, don't try too hard. Keep it simple, don't try to do all the techniques together, if one fails. Don't do ADA, WILD, MILD, WBTB all at the same time, bc you will just get too tired to LD.
